definition.core_axiom: Lorehold treats the past as an active force: excavate it, preserve it, argue with it, and revive it into present action.
definition.primary_tension: White preservation, precedent, order, and custodianship versus red discovery, impulse, adventure, and the emotional truth of history.
false_positive_guardrails: Do not flatten Lorehold into generic Boros combat; its combat is history, precedent, and memory put into action.
Do not treat the graveyard as generic death magic; Lorehold graveyard use is excavation, testimony, and reconstruction.
Do not treat artifacts as tinkering-only; in Lorehold they are relics, monuments, maps, evidence, and remembered tools.
